subject: [PATCH v6 2/2] iommu/arm-smmu-v3: Default queue depths to one page in a kdump kernel

reviews.author: Jason Gunthorpe
reviews.summary: Gave an LGTM and a Reviewed-by tag, indicating the logic looks correct.

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a memory allocation issue in the iommu/arm-smmu-v3 driver, specifically for kdump kernels. The SMMUv3 queues are allocated at their maximum hardware size, causing out-of-memory errors when the capture kernel runs from a small crashkernel reservation. The patches default the queue depths to one page worth of entries in a kdump kernel, reducing memory allocation and resolving the issue.
